classification.summary: ParticleExchange.onERC721Received() was callable directly rather than only from a real ERC721 transfer, so the attacker supplied a hand-built Lien struct with an attacker-controlled collection address and made the exchange settle a loan against a worthless NFT, releasing the pool's WETH.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

lastCodeChange.description: Legacy basis: latest of 2 pre-incident Upgraded event(s).

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/particle-trade.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.

sources.note: onchain review: ParticleExchange 0xe4764f9cd8ecc9659d3abf35259638b20ac536e4 created 2023-10-02T23:57:35Z by 0x777777bdaae4d3e6babe3aec1d40bc9caa4f7f65, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment. ~50 ETH x $2,773.01 at incidentTimestamp 1707977327 (DefiLlama) = $138,651.

re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CONFIRMED deployment basis. The recorded victim is the UUPS implementation, not the live exchange - storage slot 0 reads 0xff (`_disableInitializers()` in the constructor) and it is never entered directly in the exploit tx. The live proxy is 0x7c5c9afecf4013c43217fb6a626a4687381f080d (created 2023-09-07T20:35:23Z, first Upgraded to 0x674ac9250fc4a5e54b129206a8ed817d22ffe2c6); it emitted Upgraded to the recorded implementation at block 18266339, 2023-10-03T00:09:23Z - 708 s after that implementation's own deployment - and never again before the incident, so the deployment basis is exact to within 12 minutes either way.

onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0xe4764f9cd8ecc9659d3abf35259638b20ac536e4 to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0x7c5c9afecf4013c43217fb6a626a4687381f080d, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (11686272s -> 11685564s)
